propositions: PASS-path reuse (idempotent_reuse) synthesizes empty blocking/advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying stored sidecar findings, losing advisory and coaching from the last real review
BLOCK-path reuse (verdict_reuse) correctly replays stored blocking/advisory/coaching with reuse notation; PASS-path must match this behavior
PASS reuse must read the latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar and populate the verdict with stored advisory/coaching/indeterminate and coverage counts when the sidecar fingerprint matches

CLI notation must unmistakably indicate that rendered findings are from the last review replayed because the plan is unchanged, not a fresh LLM run, with --force pointer and recency anchor when available
Fail-open degradation to empty lists must preserve when sidecar is absent, unreadable, mismatched, or contradictory, while attestation remains the validity authority
Both reuse paths must set coverage.replayed_review metadata and maintain llm_ran=False and existing reuse flags for machine-readable output
